summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on how to visually communicate a change in data metrics on the client-facing dashboard. Initially, [me] suggested using the dataset selector date for recalculation as an indicator of data changes, arguing that the application build date was not informative enough.

However, [p5] clarified that the marker needed to be visible directly on the dashboard chart so the client could understand why the data changed from a specific day onward. This required finding a solution compatible with the charting library (chart.js).
decisions: A method must be found to visually mark the date of data change directly on the dashboard chart for client visibility.
action_items: Someone needs to devise a technical solution for marking the data change date on the chart, considering the limitations of chart.js.
